env_files.role: Interleaved campus meter register containing baseline and October readings, corrected revisions, and non-final distractor rows
Facility names, campus areas, occupied square feet, load classes, review scope, intensity eligibility, and profile state
Meter-to-facility mappings with active windows, meter roles, and mapping states
Approved, draft, expired, and future calibration records with effective windows and calibration families
Demand-watch thresholds keyed by load class, campus area, effective cycle, and state
Review-cycle pointers and protocol references without precomputed answers
Natural-language eligibility, deduplication, join, aggregation, normalization, threshold, comparison, and audit instructions

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case: web access is not allowed; solve from env files only.

notes: Very hard closed-env data-insight case with 24 facilities, multi-meter aggregation, revision resolution, temporal joins, calibration-family filtering, composite threshold lookup, baseline normalization, and audit reconciliation.
